svg.aria-label: Back-end and cloud. Services and apps on AWS, in Python, Node.js, React and Next.js: Linux servers on EC2, microservices on ECS Fargate, provisioning with Terraform and CloudFormation. Docker, CI/CD and APIs with FastAPI and Swagger. Git on GitHub and GitLab. Technologies: Python, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, AWS, CloudFormation, Terraform, CI/CD, GitHub, GitLab. Machine learning and research. Applied research in sensor fusion with FBG sensors, using neural networks, LLMs and time series. In software development, I use LLMs and AI agents, with Claude and Codex, for implementation and review. Technologies: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenAI Codex, Claude. Front-end. Interfaces in React, Next.js, SvelteKit and TypeScript, with HTML, CSS and Sass, and design in Figma. Projects include a Pomodoro timer, a WhatsApp Web clone, a product catalog and a contact list. Technologies: React, Next.js, SvelteKit, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Figma.
